sections.title: Questions Students Ask
sections.subtitle: Answers to common questions that students have about Kidato.

faqs.question: Will classes help with my school work?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our teachers design classes to support what you're learning in school. We can help you understand difficult topics, prepare for exams, and complete assignments with confidence.

faqs.question: What if I miss a class?
faqs.answer: Don't worry! Many classes are recorded so you can watch them later. If you know you'll miss a class, just let your teacher know in advance.

faqs.question: Do I need to turn on my camera?
faqs.answer: We encourage students to turn on their cameras during class to create a more interactive learning environment, but we understand if you're not comfortable. Talk to your teacher about options.

faqs.question: Can I take classes with my friends?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can invite friends to join your class or sign up for the same group sessions together. Learning with friends can make the experience even more fun.
